about:
Innovative Circuits Arizona (ICA) operates from Gilbert, Arizona, providing electronics contract manufacturing and CNC machining services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

ICA runs a 3,000-square-foot surface-mount technology (SMT) area with controlled temperature, humidity, and ESD compliance, alongside through-hole assembly capabilities. Its CNC machining cell includes 3-, 4-, and 5-axis machines for metals, plastics, and specialty materials. The shop supports prototype through low- to medium-volume production, and offers in-house inventory management via a Juki ISM Fortress humidity-regulated tower, materials procurement, and a full test suite: in-circuit testing, functional testing, environmental stress screening, automated optical and X-ray inspection.

The company serves aerospace, medical, automotive, industrial, and telecommunications sectors, including automotive electronics and medical device customers. Its quality system is certified to AS9100 and ISO 9001, with adherence to IPC standards, though CNC machining and design fall outside the certified scope.

ICA emphasizes nimble, adaptable production to meet shrinking product lifecycles, combining rapid prototyping, real-time quality data loops, and scalable manufacturing to reduce time-to-market for clients in highly regulated industries.
